scope: Visual inspection of actual local screenshot artifacts after independent 28-check responsive browser review. No live provider, campaign approval, publication or delivery acceptance.
disposition: Accepted for bounded local public consent presentation after scoped anchor repair.
observations: The company/program heading is fully readable after the scoped scroll margin repair; earlier images visibly clipped it behind the fixed navigation.
Brand, texting number, question-only purpose, pending status, frequency, rates, STOP/HELP and policy links are grouped in the same rendered card.
The illustrative question and exact planned sign-in reply are labelled as an example, not a delivered text or subscription.
The mobile footer has a readable Customer Care texting link alongside privacy and general terms. The proportional logo and footer links fit the viewport.
No horizontal text overflow is visible at 320 or 1440 pixels. Browser checks also passed at 390 pixels.

An existing floating chat launcher overlaps a trailing part of the long mobile card at one scroll position. Required SMS/policy links remained usable in the actual keyboard/click journey; no general widget redesign is part of this acceptance.
limitations: Google Fonts CSS requests were deliberately blocked; these screenshots use the site's defined local font fallback.
Public consent wording does not establish carrier approval. The observed live public GET bytes precede these local repairs.
No account access, provider API, message, email, model call or physical HTTP request was performed by this UI review.
